title: _PrecisionTimestampType
description: An absolute timestamp with attosecond precision. Stores seconds and attoseconds as unsigned integers with an explicit sign. Optionally carries a timescale, reference frame, and measurement uncertainty (in attoseconds).

seconds.description: The whole-seconds component of the timestamp (unsigned).

attoseconds.description: The sub-second component in attoseconds (10^-18 s). Valid range: 0 to 999_999_999_999_999_999.

referenceFrame.description: The reference frame for the timestamp (e.g. 'EarthCenter', 'SolarSystemBarycenter').

uncertainty.description: The measurement uncertainty of the timestamp, expressed as a non-negative magnitude in attoseconds (10^-18 s).
